suggested_tuning: Region: Recommend routing EU traffic to eu-west-1 (or eu-central-1) — set region per-client or use geo-DNS to reduce network RTT
Timeouts: Increase client timeout to 60s for long summaries OR switch to streaming so UI receives tokens progressively; avoid hard 30s client cutoff
Prompt guidance: Reduce max_tokens for 1st pass (e.g., 200-400) and then request extended summaries only on demand; use extractive summarization prompts to limit generation length
Streaming: Enable streaming for chat to improve perceived latency; implement incremental render in UI
Caching: Add prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts and common instruction tokens to save compute and lower tail latency
Batching/backoff: For burst traffic, implement exponential backoff + jitter on client side and queue small bursts; consider small client-side batching for embeddings/reranking workloads
Model selection: Try smaller footprint model for routine support replies (faster inference) and route to larger model for escalation; use fallback policies in SDK
Monitoring: Add token-level timing logs (request start, server accept, first-byte, completion) and share sample traces with Redwood SE for deeper analysis
Quota/cost: Enable per-route cost logging in Console to detect cost spikes from long max_tokens
